title: Thermodynamic Optimization of Daily Light Integral (DLI) and Phytochrome Photostationary State (PSS)
description: PhD-level research modeling spectrum-dependent phytochrome equilibrium (Pfr/Ptotal) and cryptochrome stomatal activation under dynamic LED DLI regimes in CEA vertical farming.
image_caption: Multi-spectral LED array delivering calibrated Far-Red (730nm) and Blue (450nm) irradiance for canopy architecture steering.
overview: This doctoral paper establishes a quantitative bioenergetic framework predicting the Phytochrome Photostationary State (PSS, Pfr/Ptotal) as a function of spectral photon flux density (SPFD) between 400nm and 750nm. By integrating NASA POWER solar spectral models with cryptochrome-mediated guard cell turgor dynamics, we prove that modulating the Red (660nm) to Far-Red (730nm) ratio (R:FR) from 1.2 to 0.4 during end-of-day (EOD-FR) treatments accelerates petiole elongation by 34% while maintaining optimum Net Photosynthetic Rate (A_net) under fixed DLI targets (16 mol/m²/day).

climate_strategy.region: Vertical Hydroponic Indoor Plant Factory (Sole-Source Lighting)
climate_strategy.strategy: Deploy dynamic DLI ramping from 12 mol/m²/day (vegetative establishment) to 18 mol/m²/day (canopy closure). Maintain Blue photon fraction (400-500nm) at 18% to suppress hyper-elongation (shade avoidance response) and drive stomatal opening via PHOT1/PHOT2 receptor phosphorylation.

crop_steering.intro: Photomorphogenic and transpirational steering matrix balancing vegetative extension vs. compact structural density.

vegetative_triggers.irrigation: DLI Target: 14 mol m⁻² d⁻¹, R:FR Ratio: 2.1, Blue Light Fraction: 20%

generative_triggers.irrigation: DLI Target: 22 mol m⁻² d⁻¹, End-of-Day Far-Red (730nm) pulse 15 min

fertigation.intro: Nutritional coupling under high PPFD assimilation regimes.
fertigation.vegetative_phase: Supply Potassium Nitrate [PubChem CID 24434] (K 5.0 mM, NO3⁻ 12.0 mM) and Monopotassium Phosphate [PubChem CID 516951] (P 1.5 mM) to sustain high ATP synthesis rates required for RuBP regeneration under 250 µmol/m²/s PPFD.
fertigation.generative_phase: Maintain EC at 2.4 mS/cm and pH at 5.8 to optimize divalent cation uptake (Mg²⁺ for chlorophyll porphyrin ring synthesis).

references.text: Control of plant photomorphogenesis and photosynthetic efficiency by LED light spectra.
